viewsContainers.activitybar.0.title: Code Detective
views.codeDetective.0.name: Code Guide
command.openMapPanel: Open Call Graph in Editor Tab
command.generateFromCursor: Code Detective: Start Walkthrough from Here
chatParticipants.0.description: Reads real source code to craft a step-by-step mentor walkthrough and call graph
chatParticipants.0.commands.0.descriptio: Trace a flow and generate a guided walkthrough
chatParticipants.0.commands.0.sampleRequ: The full flow from clicking the bag button to refreshing the item list
languageModelTools.0.userDescription: Search workspace source by keyword and return files and line numbers
languageModelTools.0.modelDescription: Search workspace source by keyword or regex; returns file, line and the full line text. Use it to locate entry functions and call sites.
languageModelTools.0.query.description: Text to search for; substring match by default
languageModelTools.0.regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression
languageModelTools.0.glob.description: Optional extra file filter, e.g. src/**/*.ts
languageModelTools.0.maxResults.descript: Maximum number of matches to return
languageModelTools.1.userDescription: Read a line range of a workspace file, with line numbers
languageModelTools.1.modelDescription: Read a line range of a workspace file and output it with line numbers. Always use these line numbers.
languageModelTools.2.userDescription: Write a guided walkthrough and call graph as a JSON file and open it in the sidebar
languageModelTools.2.modelDescription: Save an explored flow as a Code Detective guide and call graph. Provide file/startLine/endLine/note for sources; the extension fills anchorText from real files, validates and opens it.
languageModelTools.2.sources.description: Source location table keyed by sourceId
languageModelTools.2.sources.symbol.desc: Enclosing function or Class.method symbol for this slice; optional
languageModelTools.2.sources.variantLabe: Short variant/channel tag when this source is one of a node's parallel implementations; optional
languageModelTools.2.sources.note.descri: One sentence on what these lines do; shown at the end of the code line
languageModelTools.2.nodes.parent.descri: Top-level stage node id this function belongs to (at most 1 level); omit for top level
languageModelTools.2.nodes.sourceMode.de: How multiple sources on one leaf node relate: slices (same function) or variants (parallel implementations)
languageModelTools.2.edges.branch.descri: Branch condition, e.g. "cache miss"; omit for the main path
languageModelTools.2.edges.via.descripti: Ordered sourceIds of intermediate pass-through forwarding hops between from and to
languageModelTools.2.walkthrough.sourceI: Source id in sources focused by this step
languageModelTools.2.walkthrough.why.des: Why the code is written this way
languageModelTools.2.walkthrough.skip.de: Details safe to skip on a first read
languageModelTools.2.walkthrough.example: What happens to the running example at this step
languageModelTools.2.walkthrough.aside.d: Side-path step: off the main line, expanded inline from another step's branches
languageModelTools.2.walkthrough.branche: Ids of aside steps reachable from this step
languageModelTools.2.tour.example.descri: One concrete example that runs through the whole guide
languageModelTools.2.tour.recap.descript: Summary shown after the last step
languageModelTools.2.tour.exercise.descr: A small hands-on exercise to check understanding
configuration.0.title: Code Detective
config.ai.agent.enum.copilot: GitHub Copilot (prefers local copilot CLI; falls back to VS Code Language Model API inside VS Code)
config.ai.agent.enum.claude: Claude Code CLI (claude -p, read-only workspace tools)
config.ai.agent.markdownDescription: Which AI engine generates guides and answers step questions (`copilot`, `agy`, `codex`, `claude`, or a custom CLI id from `codeDetective.ai.cli.agents`). When unset, auto-detects the first available engine in priority order.
config.ai.cli.command.markdownDescriptio: Path to the agent executable; leave empty to use the agent id (`copilot` / `agy` / `codex` / `claude`). The prompt is passed via stdin, never through a shell.
config.ai.cli.extraArgs.markdownDescript: Extra arguments appended after the built-in ones, e.g. to pass `--model`.
config.ai.cli.allowedTools.markdownDescr: Tools Claude Code may use. Keep them read-only so the agent cannot modify workspace source.
config.ai.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: Timeout for one agent call (ms). Default 5 minutes.
colors.focusBorder: Left border of the code range for the current step.
colors.mapBackground: Line spotlight background of the current step.
colors.callBackground: Inline highlight background of key function calls in the current step.
colors.mapBorder: Subtle left border of the enclosing function scope when narrowing to key calls.
